stages.title: Story Campaign & Ch.1–5 Safeguards
stages.summary: Finish Chapters 1–5 once with HUD Criminal Profile ON; catch Lucia’s Ch.1 balcony meditation right after Down to Earth before Tourist Trap and drop Manual Save #1.
stages.gate: Gate: Ch.1 Down to Earth -> Tourist Trap (#28) + Pre-Ch.4 Save (#48)

stages.title: Character Strands, Garages & Unlocks
stages.summary: Complete Cal, Moses (8 Garages + 10 Scooter Bros rides), Billy, Kenton (7 shipwrecks), Randy (16 sports cars), Andy (Lucia), Tyrone & Bret (Jason), plus an early TV Arcade run.
stages.gate: Risk: Protagonist locks (Lucia/Jason) & Kenton Ch.2–3 call trigger

stages.title: Heists, Combat Focus & Co-Op Feats
stages.summary: Pull 5+ Bank Vaults & launder $250k, hit 3 jewelry shops back-to-back with partner, train paired max Strength, rob Kingpin Bowling’s 3 valuables, and raid Mile Zero Rhinos & VCIA.
stages.gate: Risk: Ch.2 Coffee Break co-op unlock & Kingpin Bowling respawn window

stages.title: Leonida Stunts, Ranges & Collectibles
stages.summary: Unfog all 52 areas, gold 42 Shooting Ranges (12 sites), win 14 Top Fun Drone Hubs & 20 races, scan 100 WAiNK spots, clear 250/300 Stunts, 50/70 Challenges, 3 Card sets & 8 Strangers.
stages.gate: Zero missables; progress carries into free-roam post-credits

stages.title: Easter Eggs, 100% Checklist & Platinum
stages.summary: Check Progress > Stats > 100% Completion (~60% true buffer: 200 vehicles, 100 animals, 70/80 challenges), clear Ocean Beach & UFO Easter eggs, spend $100k, and pop Platinum #1.
stages.gate: Zero mission replay required; clean up freely before final Platinum sync

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Awarded automatically once all 54 single-player PS5 trophies across GTA VI unlock. Zero online modes, zero difficulty toggles, and zero mission gold medals stand between your save and the Platinum.

steps.text: Confirm cheats stay disabled on your main save file, because any cheat locks saving and blocks all trophy triggers.
Enable HUD progress and Criminal Profile notifications on launch so live counters for challenges and profile actions stay visible.
Create chapter-boundary manual saves across the 15 manual slots, since GTA VI omits post-credits mission replay.
Trigger Lucia’s Chapter 1 kitchen dialogue and back-deck meditation right after Down to Earth before Tourist Trap starts.
Play through Chapters 1–5 at your own pace while casually WAiNK-scanning unfamiliar vehicles and studying animals with binoculars.
After Starting From Zero, continue into open-world free-roam to unlock the 35-item 100% Checklist in Progress > Stats.
Knock out mandatory 100% categories: all 8 Bank Vaults, 39 Gang Ops, 12 Shooting Ranges, 14 Drone Hubs, and Bret’s 15 Target Decks.
Use generous 100% buffers: finish 300 of 397 Stunts (after 250 for Cunning Stunts), 70 of 80 Challenges, and 15 of 18 Meditations.
Wrap up 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks strands outside the 100% checklist (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete, and four more).
Finish remaining standalone trophies (Blue Banshee showroom smash, Little Cuba Payday Loans foot escape, Starlet Motel UFO) to pop Platinum.

dispute.sideAText: PowerPyx, PSNProfiles, and IGN estimate ~200h (4/10 difficulty) when scanning vehicles and animals early during story missions.
dispute.sideBText: Push Square and Eurogamer project 250–300+ hours for completionists who clear optional hourglass missions before cleanup.
dispute.ourCall: Expect ~190–215 hours by passive-scanning 200 vehicles and 100 animals during Chapters 1–5 instead of grinding them post-credits.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unlocks automatically after completing Gone Fishing, the opening Chapter 1 mission following the Prologue robbery.

steps.text: Finish the opening Prologue robbery sequence in Vice City to reach Key Lento.
Follow the pink story marker for Gone Fishing as Jason.
Complete boat navigation and dock arrival objectives alongside your crew.
No optional bonus objectives or gold medals exist, so focus purely on survival.
Keep auto-save active or drop Manual Save #1 once Jason wakes up in Key Lento.
Confirm HUD notifications are enabled immediately after controls unlock in free-roam.
Check Jason’s safehouse TV and workout area after returning from the water.
Inspect the Progress menu to see the first story completion tick registered.
Verify PS5 Trophy Tracker shows 1/55 unlocked before chasing Chapter 1 side activities.
Watch out right after Down to Earth for the optional Lucia balcony meditation.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Automatic story trophy triggered after wrapping Chapter 1 in Key Lento and completing the first Chapter 2 mission, What’s in the Bag?.

steps.text: Finish every mandatory pink-marker main mission in Key Lento across Chapter 1.
Complete Down to Earth to meet Brian and advance the main Key Lento storyline.
Before locking into the chapter closer Tourist Trap, finish Lucia’s deck meditation as a safeguard.
Make Manual Save #2 prior to starting Tourist Trap since there is no mission replay.
Beat Cal in his optional fishing marker if convenient while already stationed near Key Lento.
Expect Kenton’s shipwreck strand to pause temporarily once Chapter 1 wraps up.
Launch Tourist Trap when ready to resolve the Key Lento finale.
Transition into Chapter 2 and play through the opening mission, What’s in the Bag?.
Watch the trophy trigger immediately after What’s in the Bag? concludes rather than at Chapter 1 credits.
Drop Manual Save #3 right after entering Chapter 2 free-roam.

dispute.sideAText: Early spoilers assumed Paradise Lost popped right when Tourist Trap ended Chapter 1.
dispute.sideBText: Verified PS5 trophy timestamps trigger right after completing Chapter 2 opener What’s in the Bag?.
dispute.ourCall: Do not worry if Tourist Trap credits roll silently — complete What’s in the Bag? to unlock Paradise Lost.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Automatic story milestone awarded upon completing Chapter 2 and finishing Welcome to Vice City at the start of Chapter 3.

steps.text: Progress all Chapter 2 pink main missions across Kelly County and Port Gellhorn.
Complete Coffee Break to unlock dual-protagonist callouts and free-roam partner switching.
Complete Breakfast Run mid-chapter to pick up the standalone Trust bronze trophy.
Finish Daily Driver for Moses to install the Vice City Real Estate phone app.
Deliver a starter ride for Moses to install the Scooter Bros delivery app on your phone.
Grab the Kingpin Bowling valuables during Hit Kingpin Bowling if convenient to save a respawn wait.
Keep a dedicated Chapter 2 manual save before advancing toward the chapter climax.
Watch for Bret Vogel’s Jason-only text message opening his 15-deck hunting trail.
Complete the first Chapter 3 opener, Welcome to Vice City, after Chapter 2 wraps.
Confirm T**s Ass Drug Money pops on PS5 as you enter Vice City.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Automatic story progression trophy that pops once Chapter 3 finishes and both opening Chapter 4 missions (Ocean Beach and Another Life) conclude.

steps.text: Complete all Chapter 3 vice-city operations involving Raul’s crew and cartel targets.
Finish Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs to unlock the Snap Gun stealth tool and Jewelry Store targets.
Complete Credit Check to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer and Payday Loans vault targets.
Finish Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs to obtain the Key Cloner for Randy’s Wish List and Showroom exits.
Play Here, Kitty Kitty to unlock Tyrone’s Jason-exclusive Kitty Litter synthetic lab chain.
Expect The Cartel Heist to award Break the Bank along the main Chapter 3 path.
Watch for Andy’s Lucia-only Belville phone call when roaming Chapter 3 free-roam.
Create a pre-finale Chapter 3 manual save before finishing the chapter sequence.
Enter Chapter 4 and complete its opening main mission, Ocean Beach.
Finish the follow-up Chapter 4 mission, Another Life, directly afterward.

dispute.sideAText: Generic trophy lists imply Chapter 3 completion triggers at the final Chapter 3 mission.
dispute.sideBText: PowerPyx and PSNProfiles confirm two Chapter 4 missions (Ocean Beach + Another Life) must clear first.
dispute.ourCall: Play straight through Ocean Beach and Another Life at the start of Chapter 4 to register Chapter 3.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Automatic story milestone awarded when you complete Starting From Zero, the climactic mission closing Chapter 4.

steps.text: Work through Chapter 4’s escalating Vice City and coastal main operations.
Complete Child’s Play to unlock the Family Matters story trophy automatically.
Complete Headliners to secure DWNFALL along the central story path.
Complete VCIA Takedown to trigger the Hi-Jacked story milestone.
Watch for the optional mission That’s Where The Money Is… at the cafe to unlock 8 Bank Vaults.
Save a clean manual slot prior to entering late Chapter 4 endgame sequences.
Verify your Criminal Profile status has not tipped into permanent Irredeemable aggression early.
Keep stocked up on body armor and Zombix before starting Starting From Zero.
Finish Starting From Zero to resolve the Chapter 4 arc cleanly.
Collect Top Of The World, Ma as the post-mission transition begins.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold campaign trophy earned by completing the final main mission in Chapter 5, after which GTA VI drops you into open free-roam prior to the finale.

steps.text: Complete Operation Savage Glory inside Chapter 5 to unlock Snow Storm.
Keep a manual Chapter 5 save slot before triggering the final story sequence.
Ensure no cheat codes are toggled active during the endgame sequence.
Stock full body armor, rifle ammo, and healing items from Ammu-Nation ahead of the final mission.
Complete the closing campaign mission cleanly without needing any gold-medal sub-objectives.
Enjoy the credits — finishing the campaign unlocks the 100% Completion Checklist in Progress > Stats.
Allow the post-credits load to place Jason and Lucia back into Leonida free-roam before the final point of no return.
Note that both home workout equipment and full character switching stay accessible post-story.
Verify You Gotta Know When to Get Off pops on PS5 alongside any unlocked end-story trophies.
Proceed straight into Stage 2/3/4 cleanup via Progress > Stats > 100% Completion.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Unmissable Chapter 2 campaign trophy awarded directly upon finishing the mission Breakfast Run.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 2 by clearing Chapter 1 and What’s in the Bag?.
Follow the pink-icon story chain across Port Gellhorn and Kelly County.
Launch the Breakfast Run main mission when its pink icon appears.
Complete the combat and escape beats as Jason/Lucia without needing stealth bonuses.
Remember there are no replayable mission scorecards, so no gold medal stress applies.
Use Combat Focus (L3+R3 while aiming) during tight interior shootouts to practice Gunslinger.
Loot dropped enemy cash and heal with Zombix if armor breaks during extraction.
Shake police sightlines using side alleys or backroads to finish the mission cleanly.
Watch Trust unlock automatically as Breakfast Run finishes.
Keep scanning parked and passing vehicles with WAiNK after returning to free-roam.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Unmissable Chapter 3 campaign trophy earned by completing the centerpiece mission The Cartel Heist.

steps.text: Advance through Chapter 3 main operations until The Cartel Heist unlocks.
Stock body armor and a high-accuracy rifle like the Duke 556 beforehand.
Follow objective prompts through the cartel compound infiltration and vault sequence.
Use cover and Combat Focus to clear heavy waves without wasting armor vests.
Coordinate handoffs and vehicle exfiltration along the scripted getaway path.
Avoid enabling any cheat toggles that could suppress trophy sync.
Complete the escape phase to trigger mission clear.
Collect Break the Bank automatically once The Cartel Heist concludes.
Use your hefty mission payout toward Vice City Real Estate garages afterwards.
Check Chapter 3 side strands for Andy and Tyrone in free-roam.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Unmissable Chapter 4 campaign trophy triggered automatically upon completing Child’s Play.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 4 by completing Chapter 3 plus Ocean Beach and Another Life.
Follow the pink main-story trail to unlock Child’s Play.
Equip full vests and reliable automatic firearms before starting the mission.
Complete all dialogue, infiltration, and combat encounters inside the mission.
No stealth-only restriction blocks this trophy, though silent takedowns preserve armor.
Stay alert to vehicle pursuit routes during the exit sequence.
Shake all pursuing units to clear the final checkpoint.
Confirm Family Matters unlocks as Child’s Play ends.
Review Progress > Challenges afterward to see any combat milestones ticked.
Continue tracking Chapter 4 missions toward Headliners and VCIA Takedown.
Maintain a clean Chapter 4 manual backup save.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Unmissable Chapter 4 campaign trophy earned automatically by finishing the main mission Headliners.

steps.text: Progress Chapter 4 past Child’s Play until Headliners activates on your map.
Stock up on ammo, healing items, and body armor at Ammu-Nation.
Travel to the pink mission marker in Vice City to start Headliners.
Navigate the venue sequence and stay inside mission bounds during set-pieces.
Clear hostile security waves using Combat Focus headshots for quick tempo.
Escort key characters or protect mission transport during the second half.
Complete the extraction leg cleanly.
Watch DWNFALL unlock directly after mission completion.
Scan nearby exotic cars outside Vice Beach venues with WAiNK afterward.
Keep checking progress on Randy’s Wish List if visiting east Vice City.
Save your Chapter 4 progress before starting VCIA Takedown.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Unmissable Chapter 4 story trophy triggered automatically when you complete VCIA Takedown.

steps.text: Advance the Chapter 4 main story past Headliners to unlock VCIA Takedown.
Bring long-range accuracy weapons and full armor to Vice City International Airport.
Follow mission cues across airport tarmac, hangars, and runway zones.
Use tactical cover against airport security and armored support.
Complete all flightline and getaway steps as prompted by the mission flow.
Remember VCIA Takedown is separate from the free-roam passenger jet trophy Catch Me If You Can.
Finish the getaway segment cleanly without failing mission timers.
Collect Hi-Jacked automatically as VCIA Takedown completes.
Afterward in free-roam, you can steal a docked E3/E4 passenger jet for Catch Me If You Can.
Also watch for That’s Where The Money Is… optional bank-vault opener in Chapter 4.
Update your rotating manual save slot post-mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Unmissable Chapter 5 campaign trophy earned automatically by finishing the mission Operation Savage Glory.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 4 (Starting From Zero) to unlock Chapter 5 operations.
Check armor, ammo reserves, and Zombix charges before launching Operation Savage Glory.
Follow pink story markers to initiate the Chapter 5 military/assault operation.
Use heavy weapons or explosives when armored targets appear.
Stay close to cover between waves during intense firefights.
Complete the extraction sequence safely to finish the mission.
Receive Snow Storm automatically as Operation Savage Glory concludes.
Prepare a clean pre-finale manual save before wrapping Chapter 5.
Notice the final chapter flows straight toward You Gotta Know When to Get Off.
Expect the full 100% Completion tracker to unlock right after the finale.
Confirm zero cheats have ever been activated on your trophy save.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold trophy awarded for fulfilling all 35 requirements on the Progress > Stats > 100% Completion checklist. Everything on the checklist tracks from Ch.1 and remains accessible in post-story free-roam, requiring roughly 60% true total content.

steps.text: Complete the main story campaign first so Progress > Stats > 100% Completion becomes visible in the pause menu.
Knock out 100 Optional Missions (purple or black-with-pink icons) from over 250 available tasks including Moses and Randy deliveries.
Scan 200 of 277 base model vehicles using WAiNK (hold L1 then R1/R2), covering cars, boats, and aircraft.
Study 100 of 255 animal species through binoculars (L1 weapon wheel -> L2 zoom -> hold R1); every dog/cat breed counts.
Clear 300 of 397 Stunts across Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights, and Base Jumps.
Finish all 8 Large Bank Vaults (mandatory 100% item) and all 39 Illegal Gang Operations across all 9 gangs.
Earn Gold Medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges across 12 locations and win all 14 Top Fun Drone Hubs.
Complete all 15 Target Decks for Bret Vogel’s hunting chain (mandatory 100% requirement).
Meditate 15 of 18 times (switching Jason and Lucia at each spot grants +2 toward progress).
Complete any 70 of 80 In-Game Challenges, leaving up to 10 difficult challenges uncompleted.
Clear Underwater Discoveries, Robbery categories, and required property purchases listed on the 35-row stats sheet.
Verify every row hits 100% under Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to pop A Long Road.

dispute.sideAText: Early assumptions suggested 100% Completion demanded all 557 vehicles, all 255 animals, and all 397 stunts.
dispute.sideBText: PowerPyx and IGN verify strict buffers: 200/277 base vehicles, 100/255 animals, 300/397 stunts, 70/80 challenges, 15/18 meditations.
dispute.ourCall: You can safely skip 97 stunts, 10 tough challenges, and 155 animals while strictly finishing 100% required Robberies, Bret Hunts, Ranges, and Drones.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for completing any 250 of Leonida’s 397 Stunts across 4 stunt categories. Note that the 100% Completion checklist requires 300 stunts, so you will earn Cunning Stunts automatically along the way.

steps.text: Open Progress Menu > Activities > Stunts to monitor regional completion across Leonida.
Filter Map > Exploration (magnifying glass) > Stunt Spots to inspect discovered and completed named stunts.
Combine progress freely across 4 stunt classes: 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, and 25 Base Jumps.
Prioritize Under the Bridges first — flying a compact agile chopper makes them the fastest category to stack.
Skip optional bonus challenges listed inside stunt popups; simply executing the stunt once marks it completed.
Use a fast nimble motorcycle or supercar with turbo upgrades for tricky Stunt Jumps.
Fly a small aerobatic plane like a Mallard for Knife Flights between narrow skyscrapers.
Grab a parachute at Ammu-Nation or high towers before sweeping all 25 Base Jumps.
Track your PS5 trophy counter live up to 250/250.
Push 50 more easy Under the Bridges afterward to reach 300 for A Long Road.
Make a quick save between failed heavy stunt jumps to respawn cleanly nearby.

dispute.sideAText: Players often see 300/397 in endgame checklists and assume Cunning Stunts needs 300.
dispute.sideBSources: Earn Cunning Stunts at 250 mixed stunts, then add 50 easy Under the Bridges for A Long Road.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Requires completing each of GTA VI’s 9 tracked activity types at least once under Touchpad > Progress > Activities.

steps.text: Open Touchpad > Progress > Activities to view exact completion counts across all 9 activity categories.
Filter your world map to Activities (blue dumbbell icon) after unfogging Leonida districts.
Complete Fishing at least once (can be paired with Cal’s mission for Baited My Tackle).
Complete Hunting at least once (pairs directly with Bret Vogel’s Fair Game hunting strand).
Play a round of Golf at a Leonida course.
Complete any Shooting Range challenge (working toward The Shootist covers this automatically).
Play a game of Pool and score hoops in Basketball at local courts.
Play any one of the 4 Video Games on a safehouse TV or bar cabinet.
Win any Car Race, Race Challenge, or Top Fun Drone Race.
Perform at least 1 Stunt Jump, Base Jump, Bridge Fly-Under, or Knife Flight.
Watch Master of None pop automatically as soon as the 9th activity type ticks >= 1.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for earning Gold Medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges spread across all 12 Leonida Ammu-Nation and private shooting ranges. Mandatory for 100% Completion.

steps.text: Unfog the map or visit Gun Stores and Range icons (blue dumbbell filter) to locate all 12 Shooting Ranges, including Rodgers Ranch and Griffin Shooting Range.
Verify every single range houses multiple weapon tiers totaling 42 separate Gold Medal trials.
Wait until you upgrade Focus and weapon attachments (extended mags, sights, steady grips) before grinding hard gold times.
Pair Combat Focus (L3+R3) sparingly or rely on tight short-burst ADS shots to maintain high multiplier streaks.
Never shoot friendly civilian/penalty cutouts, as accuracy and streak resets tank Gold medal scores.
Use rapid-reload weapons with low recoil for SMG and AR lanes.
Switch to precision pistols with crisp iron sights for small moving steel targets.
Replay individual challenges immediately from the range counter until Gold registers.
Cross-check Touchpad > Progress > Activities > Shooting Ranges to catch missing locations.
Confirm all 12 ranges list 100% Gold before leaving.
Note that all 42 Gold medals also feed Focus XP toward Gunslinger and count toward A Long Road.
Save manually after sweeping dense Vice City ranges so no crash wipes Gold progress.

dispute.sideAText: Some guides rate Shooting Ranges and Drone Golds around 6–7/10 difficulty due to tight target timers.
dispute.sideBText: Community players report Gold timers soften dramatically after leveling Focus and adding weapon mods.
dispute.ourCall: Upgrade gun stability attachments and max Focus before tackling the trickiest Kelly County range medals.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Awarded for winning a Top Fun Drone Race across all 14 hubs in Leonida (totaling 42 drone race events across hubs). Mandatory for 100% Completion.

steps.text: Unfog Leonida and filter Activities on the map to spot all 14 Top Fun Drone van/hub locations.
Check Progress > Activities > Top Fun Drone Races to verify which hubs remain untouched.
Complete at least one race victory at every single one of the 14 hubs (all 42 events tie into 100% checklist mastery).
Practice tight yaw/pitch banking before pressing boost on urban Vice City tracks.
Feather throttle through narrow shipping containers and scaffolding checkpoints to avoid spinning out.
Watch upcoming ring orientation arrows so you line up vertical climbs early.
Avoid grazing lamp posts or palm fronds that knock drones off course.
Restart immediately via quick retry if an early crash loses more than 2 seconds.
Sweep hub by hub regionally rather than crossing the map repeatedly.
Verify 14/14 hubs show wins in your tracker so Top Fun unlocks.
Clear any remaining gold drone sub-races required by your 100% completion sheet.

dispute.sideAText: 42 races exist across 14 drone hubs, creating confusion over the bronze bar.
dispute.sideBSources: Win 1 race at all 14 locations for Top Fun, then clear remaining time trials only if polishing 100% completion.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy earned by placing 1st across 20 unique races out of 40 distinct street, off-road, and circuit race locations across Leonida.

steps.text: Filter Map > Activities for Race markers (there are 40 unique race courses across Leonida).
Win any 20 different race events — repeating the exact same race does not count.
Upgrading one fast sports car (turbo, brakes, tires) and one nimble dirt bike covers almost every class.
Join Yago’s Strangers & Freaks race strand early so your street-race wins double-dip toward Strangers & Freaks.
Use short taps of handbrake around 90-degree Vice City intersections instead of sliding wide.
Drive clean on straightaways to save turbo/nitro bursts for overtaking near final checkpoints.
Check Touchpad > Progress > Activities > Races to confirm distinct events won.
Prefer point-to-point highway sprints over multi-lap muddy circuits if purely chasing speed.
Note that you can easily skip your least favorite 20 races.
Earn Cash, Not Kudos unlocks on your 20th unique first-place finish.
Winning additional race gold medals also ticks off optional Challenges toward One Last Thing.

dispute.sideAText: Rerun farming on a single track does NOT increment Earn Cash, Not Kudos.
dispute.sideBSources: Select 20 distinct race markers under Activities > Races; skip the trickiest 20 events.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for accepting and beating Cal in his post-mission fishing duel west of Key Lento in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Progress Chapter 1 until you complete the main mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal).
Wait in free-roam until Cal texts you inviting a friendly fishing challenge.
Look for the purple fishing challenge icon just west of Key Lento.
Travel to the pier/shoreline spot and talk to Cal to begin the match.
Cast toward ripples where heavier Leonida sportfish gather rather than shallow weeds.
Watch rod tension carefully: reel hard only while the fish rests, and hold steady when it thrashes.
Pull up the rod intermittently to drag larger catches closer without snapping line.
Land a heavier cumulative catch than Cal before the round timer closes.
Beat Cal cleanly to pop Baited My Tackle and tick Fishing off Master of None.
Note that Cal’s icon remains playable post-story if skipped during Chapter 1.
Catching bonus large fish here also trains Character Focus XP early.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Requires playing through every stage to reach the end of any one of the 4 playable arcade/video games in GTA VI: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind, or Bang For Your Buck.

steps.text: Locate one of the 4 playable games: Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, and Time Jackers Rewind on your safehouse TV, or Bang For Your Buck at bars like Salty Anchor.
Interact with Jason & Lucia’s living room controllers in Chapter 1 as soon as free-roam opens.
Note that home console use temporarily locks during select story displacement chapters before unlocking again post-story.
Pick whichever cabinet or TV cartridge suits your reflexes best (Tenebrae Lux and Street Trash III are crisp single-sitting runs).
You only need to clear all stages to finish the run — high-score challenges are completely optional.
Watch enemy attack telegraphs rather than rushing, conserving continues on late boss levels.
Spend small extra cash for continues on arcade cabinets like Bang For Your Buck if needed.
Complete the final level to trigger the ending screen.
Verify Stick Fiddler pops as soon as the arcade run concludes.
Playing one video game also satisfies the Video Game slot for Master of None.
Check Progress > Activities if tracking cabinet completions.

trophies.missableWindow: Home TV controller locked during select story shifts
trophies.lastChance: Clear Tenebrae Lux or Street Trash III at home in Ch.1 or post-story free-roam

dispute.sideAText: Players displaced mid-story lose access to the Key Lento living room TV for parts of Chapters 2–3.
dispute.sideBTitle: B · Always Doable At Bars / Post-Story
dispute.sideBText: Bar cabinets like Salty Anchor stay open, and home TV access returns after credits.
dispute.ourCall: Knock out Tenebrae Lux right on your Key Lento couch in Chapter 1, or hit Bang For Your Buck at a bar anytime.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy unlocked by completing Andy’s 5-mission Lucia-only optional strand starting in Chapter 3 around Belville.

steps.text: Reach Chapter 3 in the story and switch control to Lucia while exploring free-roam.
Wait for Andy to phone Lucia and follow up with a text containing her Belville address.
Travel to the Belville quest icon as Lucia (Jason cannot trigger or progress Andy’s strand).
Complete Quest 1: Climbing the Cellerichain (Parts 1–3).
Complete Quest 2: Pay the Cellerica Fee.
Complete Quest 3: Peach! (Join the Cellerica Initiation).
Complete Quest 4: Read the Label (Retrieve the Cellerica Van).
Complete Quest 5: Puff Puff Pass (Meet at the Warehouse).
Expect Road to Rehabilitation to pop automatically upon finishing Puff Puff Pass.
Note that Andy does NOT count toward the 8 Strangers & Freaks strands, but remains available post-story.
Check Progress > Characters to track Lucia’s open quests cleanly.

trophies.missableWindow: Lucia-exclusive Belville call triggered in Ch.3
trophies.lastChance: Switch to Lucia during Ch.3 free-roam or post-story to clear all 5 Cellerica missions

dispute.sideAText: Playing exclusively as Jason in Ch.3 prevents Andy from ever phoning.
dispute.sideBTitle: B · Switch to Lucia in Ch.3
dispute.sideBSources: Spend 10 minutes free-roaming as Lucia in Chapter 3 around Belville to pop Andy’s call immediately.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy for clearing all 7 underwater shipwreck dives in Kenton Rees’s optional questline, starting after Chapter 1’s Island Dreams.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1 main mission Island Dreams (Work for Kenton) and wait for his follow-up phone call.
Visit Kenton’s green KR marker in Key Lento to start his treasure-diving chain.
Equip diving gear and use the handheld metal detector along marked purple shipwreck circles on the ocean floor.
Dig up submerged treasure chests and haul each batch back to Kenton at his shop.
Expect Kenton to become temporarily unavailable once Chapter 1 transitions into Chapter 2.
Don’t panic — switch to Jason in Chapters 2–3 and call Brian to speed up Kenton’s return text.
Wait for Kenton’s callback after turning in set #1 and again for the final set totaling 7 shipwrecks.
Watch oxygen reserves carefully during deep reef dives and carry extra dive canisters if offered.
Monitor Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees and Progress > Collections > Kenton’s Treasures.
Turn in the 7th shipwreck haul to pop This Was No Boat Accident.
Note all 7 shipwrecks remain completable post-story even if paused mid-game.

trophies.missableWindow: Kenton pauses after Ch.1 until Ch.2–3 Jason/Brian call
trophies.lastChance: Call Brian as Jason in Ch.2–3 or wait for post-story text to finish all 7 dives

dispute.sideAText: Because Kenton’s KR icon vanishes after Chapter 1, many players thought his dives became permanently locked.
dispute.sideBTitle: B · Restores via Brian Call / Free-Roam
dispute.sideBText: PowerPyx confirmed Kenton automatically texts back in Ch.2–3 (especially after Jason calls Brian) and stays open post-story.
dispute.ourCall: Do not reload an old save — advance to Ch.2–3 as Jason, phone Brian, and Kenton’s shipwreck dives reopen.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy awarded for finishing all 5 quests in Billy’s Thrillbilly Mudclub questline starting in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break to unlock Billy’s optional chain.
Check Kelly County on your map for Billy’s icon at the Thrillbilly Mudclub.
Complete Quest 1: Thrillbillies (Check Out the Mud Club).
Complete Quest 2: Twist Wrist, Smash, Grab (Join Billy on a Job).
Complete Quest 3: Mall Rats (Join Billy on a Job).
Complete Quest 4: The Impaler (Steal the Impaler).
Complete Quest 5: Hometown Heroes (Join Billy on a Job).
Upgrade an off-road 4x4 or dirt bike to keep pace easily during muddy Thrillbilly stunts.
Earn The Lone Rider upon completing Hometown Heroes.
Note Billy’s 5 quests are still playable after the story and do not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
Save afterward to keep all cash and vehicle unlocks earned with Billy.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver trophy earned by finishing 8 qualifying Strangers & Freaks mission strands across Leonida. Crucially, character trophies like Andy, Billy, Tyrone, and Kenton do NOT count toward these 8.

steps.text: Track live completion out of 8 directly on the PS5 Trophy Tracker card for Strangers & Freaks.
Distinguish true Strangers & Freaks from character quests — Moses, Tyrone, Yasmani, Andy, Billy, and Eddie do NOT count.
Complete Strand 1 — Kirk: Search for the Skunk Ape, Search for Tree Effigies, Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove.
Complete Strand 2 — Kyle: Check Out McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals for Kyle, Buddy?.
Complete Strand 3 — Yago: Join a Street Race, Bumper to Bumper, Race Against Yago, Brother to Brother.
Complete Strand 4 — Pilot Pete: Passing the Torch, Backseat Pilot, Southpoint Airfield, Avery Allen & Co., Deliver Packages.
Explore all 52 districts across Leonida to surface remaining open-world purple Stranger markers.
Remember Strangers & Freaks never expire permanently — every strand stays reachable in post-story free-roam.
Keep note that Strangers & Freaks are NOT listed on the 100% Completion checklist, so clean them up in Stage 4.
Clear 4 additional qualifying regional Strangers to hit 8/8.
Verify Strangers & Freaks pops cleanly once the 8th qualifying finale concludes.

dispute.sideAText: Many players confuse Andy, Billy, Kenton, and Tyrone purple chains as counting toward Strangers & Freaks.
dispute.sideBText: PowerPyx and PSNProfiles confirm only dedicated open-world Strangers (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete, etc.) increment the 8/8 counter.
dispute.ourCall: Watch your PS5 trophy counter after each strand finale; prioritize Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete, plus 4 unfogged open-world Strangers.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy earned by delivering all 16 high-end sports cars on Randy’s Wish List to his west Vice City garage.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3 main mission Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs (Steal the Zorrusso for Randy) to unlock Key Cloner and Wish List #1.
Check Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Randy’s Wish List to inspect remaining targets.
Scan parked luxury sports cars around Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels using WAiNK (hold L1).
Enter or scan a listed target (Pegassi Vitello, Infernus, Toros, Tempesta, Grotti Itali RSX, Banshee, etc.) to pop a delivery prompt.
Note Randy marks fixed spawn locations on your map once earlier requests are delivered.
Keep stolen exotics scratch-free on the drive back to Randy’s green RK icon in west Vice City for bigger cash payouts.
Pair Key Cloner hacks with quiet alleys so alarmed exotics don’t draw prolonged chases.
Use Pay ’n’ Spray or outrun low wanted levels before entering Randy’s delivery bay.
Remember every delivery counts toward your 100 Optional Missions buffer for A Long Road.
Verify all 16 vehicles including Piccia Furia, Ascot Paragon, Ocelot Jagular, and Baller ST-D are crossed off.
Receive Supply & Demand as the 16th exotic pulls into Randy’s garage.

dispute.sideAText: Randy only marks a handful of cars automatically on Map > Robberies.
dispute.sideBTitle: B · WAiNK Scan Ocean Beach Streets
dispute.sideBSources: Cruise Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels scanning passing exotics with WAiNK to clear all 16 wish-list cars fast.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy unlocked by completing Tyrone’s Jason-only Synthetic Labs demolition missions starting in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3 main mission Here, Kitty Kitty to initialize Tyrone’s storyline.
Switch to Jason when exploring free-roam — Tyrone’s lab quests are unavailable while playing as Lucia.
Look for purple Kitty Litter Lab icons scattered across Vice City.
Bring body armor, explosives or incendiary rounds, and suppressed rifles to each lab raid.
Clear Take Out Kitty Litter labs by neutralizing guards and sabotaging lab equipment.
Keep destroying labs until Tyrone messages Jason with his second capstone mission.
Launch Spin On This (Shut Down the Labs) when it populates as a purple quest icon.
Finish the final lab takedown and escape law enforcement or gang retaliation.
Earn Spin On This! automatically at the conclusion of Tyrone’s capstone mission.
Remember Tyrone’s strand stays accessible post-story as Jason if deferred during Chapter 3.
Note his missions also contribute toward your 100 Optional Missions total.

trophies.missableWindow: Jason-only Kitty Litter Labs unlock after Ch.3 Here, Kitty Kitty
trophies.lastChance: Play as Jason to clear purple lab icons in Vice City and unlock Spin On This

dispute.sideATitle: A · Lucia Locked Out of Labs?
dispute.sideAText: Purple synthetic lab markers vanish when controlling Lucia.
dispute.sideBSources: Control Jason after Here, Kitty Kitty so all Kitty Litter Labs and Spin On This populate.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy to meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Ten geographic locations total 18 spots when counted with Jason and Lucia, plus 1 controversial early-morning balcony session at Jason’s house right after Down to Earth in Chapter 1.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 1 main mission Down to Earth (Meet Brian) cleanly without skipping morning safehouse time.
Next morning at Jason’s Key Lento house, talk to Lucia in the kitchen until she says "You know what I’m gonna do? Meditate."
Follow Lucia outside onto the back balcony near the workout gear and watch for the optional prompt.
Hold L2 to focus on Lucia and press X to Accept before answering Kat’s call for Tourist Trap.
Drop Manual Save #1 right after finishing that balcony tutorial so you never lose Chapter 1 proof.
Continue through Chapter 2 Coffee Break so Jason and Lucia can free-roam together across all regions.
Open Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations to inspect remaining open-world spots.
Visit each of the remaining 10 open-world meditation landmarks across Leonida.
Switch between Jason and Lucia (hold + button callout) at every spot so each landmark registers +2 progress.
Complete every last meditation spot until 18/18 registers and Positive Mental Attitude pops.

trophies.missableWindow: Gate: Jason's House Deck right after Down to Earth (before Kat's call for Tourist Trap)
trophies.lastChance: Talk to Lucia in the kitchen after Ch.1 Down to Earth, follow her out to the back balcony, hold L2 + press X to accept before Tourist Trap; keep Ch.1 Manual Save #1.

dispute.sideAText: PowerPyx, PSNProfiles, and Beebom warn Jason’s back-deck tutorial vanishes permanently once Chapter 1 ends, adding +1 to Progress > Meditations.
dispute.sideBText: Push Square & community runs note the Ch.1 balcony lacks a world "Meditation Spot" icon and 100% only needs 15/18, leaving strict trophy eligibility disputed.
dispute.ourCall: Treat #28 as STRICTLY MISSABLE: complete Lucia’s balcony session right after Ch.1 Down to Earth and keep Manual Save #1 before Tourist Trap.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy unlocked during Bret Vogel’s Jason-only 15-Target-Deck hunting strand after Chapter 2’s Coffee Break.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break to enable Bret Vogel’s contact.
Switch to Jason in free-roam — Lucia never receives Bret’s incoming text message.
Wait for Bret’s text marking Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County.
Complete Veteran Hunted to receive the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 (retrievable at Ammu-Nation weapon lockers).
Open Map > Activities (dumbbell icon) > Target Deck to track all 15 hunting decks.
Use binoculars (hold L1 -> L2 zoom -> R1 study) to identify animal quality and vital zones before firing.
Take one clean precision shot with the Killtelligence SM-69 for pristine payouts (required to clear the 15 Target Decks cleanly).
Deliver requested pelts/specimens back to Bret as Jason.
Continue clearing Bret’s purple hunting icons until the unique requested beast spawns.
Note all 15 Target Decks are mandatory for the 100% Completion Checklist.
Watch Fair Game pop upon delivering the unique target animal to Bret.

trophies.missableWindow: Jason-only Bret Vogel text after Ch.2 Coffee Break
trophies.lastChance: Equip Killtelligence SM-69 as Jason to complete all 15 Target Decks

dispute.sideAText: PowerPyx notes the exact unique animal midway through Bret’s 15-deck list varies by track order.
dispute.sideBText: All guides agree completing all 15 Target Decks is mandatory for A Long Road (100% Completion).
dispute.ourCall: Finish all 15 Target Decks as Jason with the Killtelligence SM-69 to unlock Fair Game automatically along the way.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver trophy earned by completing any 3 out of 18 Collectible Card sets scattered across Leonida.

steps.text: Inspect Progress > Collections to browse the 18 available Collectible Card sets.
Focus on 3 compact sets (such as Backyard Wrestling or America’s Next Top Hooker) instead of chasing all 18.
Pair card scouting while flying between districts for WAiNK scans and stunts.
Watch minimap indicators or listen for subtle collectible chimes inside shops, motels, and gas stations.
Pick up cards inside safe backrooms whenever hitting corner stores or bowling alleys.
Remember cards inside mission buildings have alternate spawns or remain accessible post-story.
Complete Set #1 completely before spreading out across random scattered decks.
Finish Set #2 using regional Vice City card clusters.
Wrap up Set #3 along Kelly County and Port Gellhorn.
Watch Don’t Touch My Deck pop cleanly once the 3rd complete set registers.
Only chase remaining card sets if finishing optional collection goals.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver trophy earned by using your phone’s WAiNK app to scan 100 environmental points of interest across Leonida (from a larger pool of Landmarks, Curiosities, Sculptures, and No Flusher Tags).

steps.text: Unlock the WAiNK scanner app automatically during Chapter 1.
Open WAiNK quickly anytime by holding L1 and aiming with R1/R2 without digging through phone menus.
Scan Landmarks (31 total), Curiosities (35 total), Sculptures (23 total), and No Flusher Tags as you pass them.
Aim center-reticle at murals, neon signs, weird roadside statues, and plaques until the scan ring finishes.
Notice there are well over 100 valid targets across Leonida, so miss nothing if one location looks awkward.
Check Progress > Collections to confirm your running WAiNK total climbs toward 100.
Scan Vice City Ocean Beach art-deco facades first for high density per block.
Combine coastal Key Lento curiosity stops during Kenton’s treasure runs.
Keep scanning unfamiliar targets on foot whenever commuting to missions.
Note that scanning vehicles separately builds progress toward Whip It Good (100 vehicles).
Watch You WAiNKer! unlock as soon as your 100th distinct environmental scan logs.

dispute.sideAText: Players expect one rigid list of 100 landmarks to complete You WAiNKer!.
dispute.sideBSources: 31 Landmarks + 35 Curiosities + 23 Sculptures + No Flusher Tags exceed 100; scan any 100 objects cleanly.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy awarded for clearing 50 out of GTA VI’s 80 Challenges. Because 100% Completion demands 70 of 80, this unlocks automatically while avoiding the hardest 10 challenges.

steps.text: Open Touchpad > Progress > Challenges to inspect all 8 challenge categories (80 challenges total).
Verify a "Completed" checkmark appears in the bottom-right corner once any challenge finishes.
Save deliberate challenge grinding until after finishing the campaign and major activities, since ~30–40 pop passively.
Skip frustrating timed or ultra-rare challenges — you have a 30-challenge buffer for this trophy (10-challenge buffer for 100%).
Start with quick combat and robbery challenges during Gang Operations.
Clear easy exploration, swimming, driving speed, and headshot streaks along Vice Beach.
Complete basic Weapons and Marksman challenges during Shooting Range gold runs.
Pair stealth, getaway, and fencing challenges while clearing 8 Bank Vaults.
Monitor your PS5 tracker approaching 50/50.
Collect One Last Thing upon finishing challenge #50.
Push 20 more straightforward challenges afterward to reach 70/80 for A Long Road.

dispute.sideAText: 100% stats display /70 challenges while One Last Thing pops at /50.
dispute.sideBSources: Unlock One Last Thing passively at 50/80, then handpick 20 painless challenges for 70/80.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for reaching a 4-star Wanted Level while paired with your partner (after Chapter 2 Coffee Break) and escaping the red heat zone.

steps.text: Finish Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break so Jason and Lucia can free-roam together.
Hold L1/partner call button to summon your partner alongside you before engaging police.
Raise your heat to 4 stars in Vice City or start Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is… (guaranteed 4-star bank escape).
Easiest manual escape: ride a fast sports motorcycle north of Ambrosia in Kelly County directly into the long train tunnel.
Helicopters lose line-of-sight inside the tunnel and cruisers struggle to navigate train sleepers.
Keep driving until the flashing red/blue search fades AND you exit the outer red "heat" radius completely.
If a police helicopter spots you first on open highway, shoot its tail/pilot before entering cover.
Switch vehicles out of police view if your getaway ride becomes recognized.
Expect Hot Together to trigger once the red heat status clears completely.
Remember robbing all 8 Large Bank Vaults for 100% triggers 4-star escapes automatically.
Pair partner presence with Retail Therapy in the same session to knock out both co-op wanted trophies.

dispute.sideATitle: A · Flashing Stars vs Red Heat
dispute.sideAText: Escaping the blue/red cone alone leaves the outer red zone active.
dispute.sideBTitle: B · Clear Outer Red Zone With Partner
dispute.sideBSources: Summit partner first and drive out of the red heat radius via the Ambrosia train tunnel.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for robbing 3 separate shops back-to-back alongside your partner without letting your flashing Wanted Level clear between stores.

steps.text: Wait until Chapter 2 Coffee Break enables partner callouts, ideally after Chapter 3 Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs opens 3 dense Vice City Jewelry Stores.
Buy body armor, sticky bombs (Ammu-Nation or Yasmani’s back room), and Zombix healing before starting.
Summon your partner (Jason/Lucia) so both characters travel together in one fast car.
Drive to the northern Vice City cluster where 3 green robbery icons sit close together.
Hit Shop #1: grab showcase items and blow the backroom safe with sticky bombs so cops arrive BEFORE you leave.
Verify the red/blue flashing Wanted Level stays active (do NOT let it drop to calm or clear red heat).
Sprint to your car with your partner and drive straight into Shop #2 while police trail behind.
Loot registers/items in Shop #2 quickly while staying alive with Zombix and vests.
Drive directly to Shop #3 under active flashing stars and steal loot inside.
Wait ~30 seconds after exiting Shop #3 (or tap a 4th nearby store if cops arrived late at Shop #1) for Retail Therapy to pop.
Shake the heat afterward using alleys or the Ambrosia train tunnel.

dispute.sideAText: Leaving Shop #1 before police respond breaks the back-to-back chain.
dispute.sideBTitle: B · Trigger Cops Inside & Expect 30s Delay
dispute.sideBSources: Wait until police sirens lock at Shop #1 and stay inside Vice City’s 3-store jewelry loop; trophy pops ~30s after Shop #3.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for scanning or discovering 100 out of GTA VI’s 557 launch vehicles using the WAiNK app. Automatically satisfied en route to the 200 base-vehicle 100% Completion threshold.

steps.text: Unlock the WAiNK scanner in Chapter 1 so every drive contributes passively.
Hold L1 to quick-draw WAiNK without opening the full smartphone UI, then hold scan on passing vehicles.
Stand beside busy Vice City intersections and ocean marinas to scan dozens of cars, trucks, and bikes in minutes.
You do NOT need to enter or drive vehicles — scanning them adds them immediately to Progress > Vehicles.
Scan boats along Key Lento docks and commercial jets/helicopters parked at VCIA.
Check Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles anytime to inspect counts by vehicle class.
Switch districts (Port Gellhorn industrial trucks, Kelly County off-roaders, Ocean Beach exotics) to avoid duplicates.
Aim for new model silhouettes rather than color variants, since 200 base models are needed for 100%.
Receive Whip It Good automatically as soon as your 100th vehicle registers.
Keep scanning into late game toward 200/277 base vehicles for A Long Road.
Bonus: WAiNK also highlights cars wanted on Randy’s Wish List simultaneously.

dispute.sideAText: Players spend hours hijacking cars instead of using phone scans.
dispute.sideBSources: Hold L1 at major intersections to scan passing vehicles; 200 base models are needed for 100%.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for killing or incapacitating 5 gang/hostile targets inside a single activation of Combat Focus.

steps.text: Activate Combat Focus while aiming a weapon (L3 + R3) once the purple Focus bar below health/stamina is charged.
Increase your Focus rank up to Level 4 by clearing Shooting Range medals, Golf, Pool, Fishing, and combat.
Eat food/drinks or shower at your safehouse first, then consume Adrenaline (weapon wheel -> use button) to extend Focus duration.
Wear fresh body armor so you can step straight out of cover close to 5 clustered criminals.
Target an Illegal Gang Operation (not soldiers, police, or civilians, which guides warn do not reliably register).
Equip a full-auto precision assault rifle like the Duke 556 for rapid multi-target headshots.
Group 5 gang members into one sightline or hallway before activating Combat Focus.
Snap rapidly across upper chests/heads before the purple Focus meter drains.
Watch Gunslinger pop once all 5 hostile gang targets drop inside that single burst.
Retry at another of the 39 Gang Operations if one target slips behind a pillar.
Pair this naturally while grinding Pest Control.

dispute.sideAText: Guides report police and soldiers inconsistently registering multi-kills.
dispute.sideBTitle: B · Clear 5 Gang Enemies With Duke 556
dispute.sideBSources: Pop Adrenaline + armor and wipe 5 criminals inside a yellow Gang Operation using Combat Focus.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy for hijacking a commercial jet docked directly at a Vice City International Airport boarding bridge and flying clear of the airport.

steps.text: Travel to Vice City International Airport (VCIA) during free-roam with a fast car.
Crash through the perimeter security fence onto the tarmac — avoid random unboarded planes parked out in fields.
Drive directly to the terminal concourse, specifically departure gates E3/E4.
Confirm the large passenger airliner is physically docked to the passenger jet bridge (airstrip planes do NOT count).
Use the exterior maintenance stairs beside the boarding bridge to climb straight into the cabin door.
Head upstairs into the cockpit and take the controls.
Reverse the jet clear of the terminal jetway onto an open runway.
Throttle up, take off over the ocean or bay, and climb clear of security gunfire.
Fly at least 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — unlock is slightly delayed.
Watch Catch Me If You Can pop once you clear the departure buffer distance.
Keep flying afterward if unfogging coastal districts for The Goodtime State.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy for infiltrating Mile Zero Air Station in the southwest corner of the map, hijacking a Rhino military tank, and firing on incoming hostiles.

steps.text: Stock full armor and bring a fast armored car or helicopter down to Mariana County at the southwest edge of Leonida.
Locate Mile Zero Air Station sitting on the southern island base.
Approach the southeast gate or use the stunt jump ramp adjacent to the southeast entrance to breach inside.
Head straight toward the southern military motor pool where Rhino tanks are parked.
Slight immediate wanted level spikes — jump straight out and enter a Rhino hatch quickly.
Rotate the turret onto pursuing base guards and military trucks immediately.
Fire main cannon shells at incoming hostile vehicles and soldiers.
Continue eliminating enemies inside the Rhino until Challenging Tank unlocks.
Save prior to entering Mile Zero if you want to avoid steep hospital/impound fees afterward.
Remember not to trigger wanted-level cheats before the trophy syncs.
Bail into the sea or drive back north once the trophy pops.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for executing a silent, undetected backdoor heist at a Jewelry Store after unlocking the Snap Gun in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3 main mission Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs to permanently unlock the Snap Gun gadget and green Jewelry Store markers.
Pick a clean Vice City target such as Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds.
Circle behind the building to find the locked rear service door instead of smashing front display glass.
Select the Snap Gun lockpick prompt (do NOT kick the door, which trips an instant alarm).
Crouch and move quietly inside the back office without alerting staff or tripwires.
Destroy the security camera footage terminal AND disable the silent alarm panel in the backroom.
Locate the handwritten safe code note inside the office.
Open the safe cleanly with the code, collect every loot item inside, and slip back out the rear exit.
Keep undetected until safely outside on the street — unlock pops shortly after exiting.
Confirm Sneakthief triggers cleanly; reload an auto/manual save if you tripped an alarm.
Counting silent escapes here also builds Professional profile actions.

dispute.sideAText: Front glass displays trigger alarms even after picking the back door.
dispute.sideBTitle: B · Backdoor Snap Gun + CCTV + Safe Code
dispute.sideBSources: Disable cameras/alarm in the backroom first and loot solely the safe using the office note code.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver trophy for hitting 5 out of GTA VI’s 8 Large Bank Vaults and escaping police heat. All 8 vaults are mandatory for 100% Completion and earn up to $205,000 each.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is… (Wait at the Cafe) to unlock Large Bank Jobs and complete Vault #1.
If you haven’t cleared Yasmani’s two Payday Loans quests from Chapter 3, finish them so Yasmani sells Security Van tips for $10,000.
Call your partner before starting every bank vault run — one character cannot carry all cash bags alone.
Follow the purple armored security van tip to its target bank branch without spooking the convoy.
Wait for the guard to carry the briefcase inside and unlock the vault door.
Storm in immediately while the vault sits open, clear bags, and hold the handoff button to pass a bag to your partner.
Expect an instant 4-star Wanted Level (also auto-unlocking Hot Together if not yet earned).
Park a nimble sports bike nearby beforehand to slice through Vice City traffic or hit the Ambrosia train tunnel.
Swap into a hidden street vehicle once sightlines break so patrols no longer recognize your ride.
Clear 5 distinct bank vaults (track completed banks by hovering map icons) to unlock Maximum Withdrawal.
Finish the remaining 3 vaults afterward (8/8 total) for A Long Road and ~$1.5M+ easy cash.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for intercepting an Armored Truck, looting its cash, and escaping the outer red heat radius. Earned automatically during That’s Where The Money Is… or earlier in Vice City.

steps.text: Option A (Automatic): Play Chapter 4 optional mission That’s Where The Money Is… — tailing the security van to the bank vault counts automatically upon escaping.
Option B (Early Free-Roam): Patrol financial districts near Vice City banks for roaming Armored Trucks.
Grab sticky bombs from Ammu-Nation or the back room of Yasmani’s shop after Chapter 3 Yasmani’s Jewelry Jobs.
Box the armored truck in with your vehicle so it brakes to a halt.
Throw a sticky bomb onto the rear cargo doors, back away, and detonate it cleanly.
Scoop up the dropped cash bags from the open rear bay.
Expect immediate police response and a red/blue wanted pursuit.
Race away on a fast motorcycle or hit a Pay ’n’ Spray to clear heat.
Continue driving until you completely exit the red heat radius — the trophy will NOT pop until heat clears.
Watch A Classic Blitz Play unlock once you are clean.
Remember laundering stolen bills later also counts toward Dime on the Dollar.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for clearing the black fog of war across every named region and shoreline of Leonida.

steps.text: Wait until you access a fast airplane or nimble helicopter (such as at VCIA or Southpoint Airfield).
Take off and open the pause map frequently to highlight remaining dark fogged corners.
Fly systematic east-west grid sweeps across Vice City, Vice Beach, and Key Lento islands.
Extend grids west over Kelly County, Port Gellhorn, Lummox County, and the Ambrosia interior.
Don’t neglect far-southwest Mariana County and Mile Zero Air Station waters.
Sweep northern marshlands, offshore cays, and remote swamp edges until zero black patches remain.
Unfogging every district automatically reveals dozens of blue Activity icons, Gang Ops, and Strangers.
Spot any lingering tiny dark pixel strips over rural roads and pass directly above them.
Expect The Goodtime State to pop once the 52nd/final region boundary uncovers.
Use your newly revealed map immediately to plan Shooting Range and Drone Hub loops.
Also scan passing aircraft with WAiNK when touching down at airfields.
Save cleanly right after unfogging the whole state so every icon stays stamped on your map.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for robbing at least 1 Illegal Operation from each of Leonida’s 9 rival gangs (out of 39 total operations, all 39 of which are needed for 100% Completion).

steps.text: Unfog Leonida and cruise near gang turfs to make yellow Illegal Operation icons populate on your map.
Open Progress > Gangs and hover over each of the 9 gangs — bottom-right stats list how many operations you hit per gang.
Prioritize clearing at least 1 yellow compound for each of the 9 distinct gangs first to pop Pest Control.
Equip heavy armor, a Duke 556 rifle, and Zombix vests before assaulting multi-guard compounds.
Use Gang Operation clusters to farm Gunslinger (5 enemies in one Combat Focus) safely since police don’t interrupt small raids.
Check offices inside compounds for safes, weapon lockers, and golden unique collectibles (such as Kingpin Bowling).
Watch Kingpin Bowling carefully during Chapter 2 so you grab all 3 valuables if possible.
Track each gang down to confirm 1/N minimum across all 9 factions.
Receive Pest Control automatically once the 9th faction’s first compound is looted.
Continue clearing the remaining compounds up to 39/39 for A Long Road.
Sell fenced contraband and marked loot to Yasmani afterward for extra laundering progress.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy unlocked by ordering and drinking an Apple Martini at the Ocean View Rooftop Bar along Ocean Beach.

steps.text: Travel east in Vice City to the Ocean Beach boardwalk district.
Locate the Ocean View Rooftop Bar overlooking the coastline.
Take stairs or elevator access up to the open-air rooftop lounge.
Approach the main rooftop bar counter and interact with the bartender prompt.
Purchase specifically the Apple Martini cocktail from the drink list.
Do NOT sprint away right after ordering — stand next to the bar facing the view.
Consume the Apple Martini completely using the drink prompt.
Enjoy the Ocean Beach skyline panorama during the animation.
Watch In The Beginning… pop cleanly as the drink finishes.
Remember Ocean Beach also spawns high-end wish-list exotics along the street below.
Scan nearby coastal sculptures with WAiNK before leaving the block.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy and classic GTA III Easter egg: hack the specific blue Banshee inside a south Vice City car dealership using the Key Cloner and smash straight out the showroom window.

steps.text: Progress through Chapter 3 main mission Clonin’ Keys, Makin’ Gs to permanently unlock the Key Cloner.
Drive to the luxury vehicle dealership showroom located in the south of Vice City.
Walk inside and look specifically for the blue Banshee on the showroom display floor — other models will NOT pop the trophy.
Step up to the blue Banshee driver door and use the Key Cloner hack minigame to unlock it.
Hop inside and align the nose straight toward the giant glass showroom window facing the street.
Floor the accelerator and shatter directly through the plate glass onto the pavement outside.
Do NOT stop right outside on the sidewalk — unlock is slightly delayed.
Keep speeding down the street for several seconds away from the dealership.
Confirm Capital Offense pops once clear of the showroom frontage.
Wait until post-story or Chapter 3 free-roam if showroom doors are sealed during an active mission.
You can also WAiNK-scan the showroom lineup while inside to tick Whip It Good.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy for looting all 3 key valuables inside Kingpin Bowling (Port Gellhorn): the Luxury Watch, the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun, and the hallway safe (code 0300).

steps.text: Reach Chapter 2 to unlock optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn (also classified as a Gang Operation).
Wait for its robbery/gang marker to appear on your map and enter prepared with sticky bombs or safe code knowledge.
Valuable 1 (Gold Icon): Head to the southeast office to pick up the Luxury Watch.
Valuable 2 (Gold Icon): Check the table in the northeast corner to grab the unique shotgun "Gutterball Moreland 850".
Valuable 3: Locate the safe inside the northeast hallway office.
Open the safe cleanly using combination code 0300 (or blow it open with a Sticky Bomb).
Note you do NOT need to kill every enemy inside, though clearing threats keeps looting calm.
Run outside and fully escape the police search radius — the trophy only triggers after escaping cops.
Missed an item on the first run? Don’t worry — the trophy is NOT permanently missable.
Wait for the Kingpin Bowling robbery marker to respawn after a lengthy in-game cooldown, then grab whichever item you missed.
Verify Let’s Go Bowling pops once all 3 items are stolen and police pursuit clears.

trophies.missableWindow: Ch.2 Hit Kingpin Bowling compound robbery respawn timer
trophies.lastChance: Grab the luxury watch, Gutterball Moreland 850, and safe loot (code 0300) or revisit on respawn

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy earned by raising Strength to maximum rank on BOTH Jason and Lucia simultaneously.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2 main mission Coffee Break to unlock dual-protagonist callouts.
Verify current stats via Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select character > scroll down to Strength (heart icon).
Filter Map > Activities (blue dumbbell) to spot fitness clubs clustered across Vice City.
Always hold the partner summon button BEFORE working out so Jason and Lucia enter the gym together.
Purchase a gym membership if prompted at your chosen fitness club.
While you manually train on benches or weights with one character, your partner automatically trains beside you for 2x progress.
Remember safehouse home workout bars also work cleanly after finishing the main story.
Check both character Strength bars periodically so neither lags behind by half a level.
Avoid wasting gym trips solo, which doubles the real-world grinding time.
Train both protagonists until both Strength meters hit their maximum cap simultaneously.
Collect Personal Best as soon as the second character locks in max Strength.

trophies.missableWindow: Requires Ch.2 Coffee Break dual-protagonist free-roam
trophies.lastChance: Summon partner before hitting gyms so Jason and Lucia reach max Strength together

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy requiring 500 Criminal Profile-affecting actions across Professional, Hardened, Violent, Psycho, or Irredeemable behaviors — with an endgame Irredeemable police-aggression trap.

steps.text: Enable HUD feedback immediately in Chapter 1: Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On.
Watch for the small demon-face popup on the right edge of your screen confirming a profile action registered.
Monitor your exact count out of 500 via the PS5 trophy card tracker for Actions Speak Louder.
Stack Professional ticks by clearing robberies stealthily, destroying CCTV footage, and escaping cleanly.
Stack Hardened ticks by wounding hostile limbs without lethal headshots.
Stack Violent ticks naturally through gang gunfights and mandatory story combat.
Avoid reaching permanent "Irredeemable" psycho profile during Chapters 1–4, because cops begin shooting on sight.
Create a dedicated manual save in early Chapter 4 before late-story profile locks settle.
Expect 350–450+ ticks passively while finishing 100% Completion, Bank Vaults, and 39 Gang Ops.
Wait until you have earned almost every other trophy if your counter still sits below 500.
If short at the very end, farm remaining ticks quickly in Vice City crowds before reloading your clean save.
Watch Actions Speak Louder unlock right upon triggering action #500.

trophies.missableWindow: Gate: Late Ch.4–5 criminal profile lock & Irredeemable threshold (500 actions)
trophies.lastChance: Enable HUD Criminal Profile popups in Ch.1 and keep a pre-Ch.4 manual save before Irredeemable cops turn hostile on sight.

dispute.sideAText: Pushing Irredeemable violence early makes police shoot on sight during tough Ch.4–5 free-roam tasks, while unmonitored HUD icons cause late panic.
dispute.sideBText: PowerPyx notes 500 profile events accrue passively across Gang Ops and 100% tasks, or can be farmed post-credits.
dispute.ourCall: Treat #48 as MISSABLE-GUARDED: enable Criminal Profile HUD popups in Ch.1 and save psycho farming strictly until after all other trophies.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy for returning alone as Lucia after Chapter 3 Credit Check to rob the exact Little Cuba Payday Loans store from the Prologue and escaping on foot.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul’s Crew) to unlock Payday Loans robberies and the Dye Pack Jammer.
Switch to Lucia and travel ALONE — do NOT summon Jason as your partner.
Navigate to the Payday Loans branch in Vice City > Little Cuba (revisiting the Prologue target).
Walk inside, aim your weapon at the counter teller, and prepare for armed security fire.
Eliminate responding security guards cleanly while wearing body armor.
Breach through the rear teller door into the cash area.
Empty all 3 cash drawers completely before heading back out the front entrance.
Do NOT enter any car, motorcycle, or boat — you MUST escape strictly on foot.
Sprint through nearby Little Cuba alleys out of the blue/red police search perimeter.
Keep running well beyond the search zone because the unlock triggers with a slight distance delay.
Watch Bad Luck, I Guess pop once your on-foot getaway finishes.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy earned by finding and completing the nocturnal UFO abduction Easter Egg northwest of Starlet Motel in Kelly County.

steps.text: Switch to solo free-roam (play alone without your partner summoned).
Travel northwest along the roadside past Starlet Motel in Kelly County.
Wait until nighttime strictly AFTER 2:00 AM in-game clock.
Scan the roadside shoulder for a mysterious stationary vehicle with blinking hazard lights.
If no blinking car spawns on your first pass, drive roughly a mile away and return to reroll the night spawn.
Once the blinking car spawns, step out and follow the dirt footpath into the dark trees beside it.
Look overhead to spot a glowing bright-blue UFO hovering over the clearing.
Walk toward the beam until the UFO drops an abducted woman onto the forest floor.
Approach the stunned woman, speak with her, and choose to help her.
Escort or follow her prompt back out to her car waiting along the highway shoulder.
Confirm The Truth Is Out There unlocks right as you get her back to the roadside vehicle.
Record a quick clip — this is Leonida’s signature paranormal encounter.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Hidden bronze trophy for riding any motorcycle and kicking down 10 pedestrians with melee bike-attacks inside a 60-second window.

steps.text: Acquire any agile motorcycle or moped/scooter (high handling beats hyperbike speed in tight sidewalks).
Cruise over to ultra-dense pedestrian promenades along Ocean Beach or downtown Vice City during daytime.
Hold your melee drive-by kick button (check weapon/controls prompt for left/right bike kick) while brushing past crowds.
Wait until the sidewalk stretches straight for at least two full city blocks before starting your 10-kick streak.
Strike pedestrians squarely so they tumble over rather than glancing harmlessly past their shoulder.
Aim roughly 1 pedestrian every 4–5 seconds — 60 seconds is plenty if you keep moderate cruising speed.
Ignore early 1-star police whistles and keep weaving up the crowded boardwalk.
Count 10 solid knockdowns rather than light bumps.
Receive Ten Pin immediately on the 10th valid knockdown within 60s.
Escape around a side avenue afterward or clear heat at a Pay ’n’ Spray.
Reload a quick save afterward if you want to keep your Criminal Profile cleaner.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for laundering $250,000 worth of stolen Marked Bills through Fence contacts after unlocking the Dye Pack Jammer in Chapter 3.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3 main mission Credit Check (Meet Raul’s Crew) to permanently unlock the Dye Pack Jammer.
Hit Payday Loans branches or Large Bank Vaults to collect stacks of Marked Bills.
Deliver marked bills to a Fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the highest exchange rate.
Avoid fences whose locations temporarily close mid-story; Yasmani and unlocked endgame fences handle full volume.
Remember $250,000 is cumulative across multiple drop-offs, not one single trip.
Pair this directly with Maximum Withdrawal: each Large Bank Vault yields up to $205,000 in minutes.
Drop by Yasmani’s shop right after shaking wanted heat on any vault job.
Only two Bank Vaults (or one Vault + couple Payday Loans) easily push laundered earnings over $250k.
Track cumulative laundered cash until the quarter-million mark clears.
Collect Dime on the Dollar on the drop-off that crosses $250,000.
Spend the newly cleaned payout immediately on the 8 garages for Little Boxes.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for spending $100,000 cumulatively across retail shops, weapon stores, tattoo studios, clothing boutiques, and car mod shops.

steps.text: Wait until you complete a few Chapter 3/4 robberies or Bank Vaults so $100k is pocket change.
Shop across any of Leonida’s 14 Mod Shops, 24 Ammu-Nations, 67 Clothing Stores, 17 Footwear Stores, 18 Salons, 11 Tattoo Studios, 15 Electronics Stores, or 19 Pay ’n’ Sprays.
Fastest high-ticket dumps: buy high-tier turbo/engine car upgrades at Mod Shops or heavy weapons/attachments at Ammu-Nations.
Stocking up on body armor vests and Zombix before Stage 2/3 missions counts passively.
Note that garage real-estate purchases on your phone count toward Little Boxes rather than retail shops.
Tattoos and luxury jackets quickly chew through remaining tens of thousands if close.
Monitor cumulative store spending on your PS5 Trophy Tracker.
Combine gun attachment shopping here before tackling Shooting Range Gold medals.
Reach $100,000 spent across any mix of stores.
Watch Treat Yo Self pop automatically on the qualifying checkout.
Save right after buying permanent weapon attachments and vehicle upgrades.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for buying all 8 purchasable garages ($160,000 total) via the Vice City Real Estate phone app unlocked in Chapter 2.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2 main mission Daily Driver (Steal the Crawler for Moses) to install Vice City Real Estate on your smartphone.
Note GTA VI features 12 total garages (4 story garages + 8 purchasable garages); only the 8 purchasable properties are needed.
Save up $160,000 total cash (easily covered by one Large Bank Vault or story heist payouts).
Open your phone and launch the Vice City Real Estate app.
Browse the map/list filter for standalone Garage properties.
Buy Garage #1–#4 around Vice City and Vice Beach first for quick personal vehicle spawns.
Buy the remaining outer county garages in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County, and Key Lento.
Remember every purchased garage expands parking slots needed to register 10 cars for On the Spot.
Verify 8/8 purchasable garages read "Owned" inside Vice City Real Estate.
Receive Little Boxes immediately after buying the 8th garage.
Use your newly unlocked parking capacity to finish On the Spot right afterward.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Bronze trophy for registering 10 stolen vehicles inside the Scooter Bros delivery app (unlocked in Chapter 2 after taking a vehicle to Moses) by visiting Moses or Pay ’n’ Sprays.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2 main mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) to install the Scooter Bros phone app.
Purchase enough garages via Vice City Real Estate first (Little Boxes) so your total parking capacity reaches at least 10 slots.
Early in Chapter 2, steal low-end street cars or motorcycles WITHOUT factory trackers.
Drive each stolen vehicle to Moses’ garage in Port Gellhorn and select Respray -> Register.
Wait until Chapter 3 unlocks Standard Tracker bypassing so you can also register mid-tier cars at any of the 19 Pay ’n’ Sprays.
Pick cheap common bikes or compacts if conserving cash, since each registration charges a fee.
Check the Scooter Bros app to confirm registered vehicle slots climb toward 10.
Note every vehicle registered lets you summon it directly to your street position anytime.
Avoid accidentally re-registering duplicates without free garage stalls.
Register your 10th valid vehicle at Moses or Pay ’n’ Spray.
Watch On the Spot unlock immediately once vehicle #10 enters the Scooter Bros roster.
